partner_result_applied.application: Used its exact decreasing Bessel density / exponential-mixture formula for G3^2+delta G4^2 inside the new Laplace inequality, yielding the same 1/[2 sqrt(2(1+delta))] ceiling on the low/intermediate-angle non-Gaussian heavy-pair branch.

mathematical_change.headline: The equal-leverage two-heavy centered-interval positive-plane stress family is now excluded for every rotation angle, not merely an open endpoint wedge.
mathematical_change.key_identity: L_a(c) <= r(q1) r(q2)/(1+2a), derived from exact Gaussian conditioning plus negative association of |S|,|D| on the uniform triangle.
mathematical_change.all_angle_result: For all c in [0,1], ||p_{T_c}||_infinity<1/(2sqrt(2)); for c>=139/141, ||p_{T_c}||_infinity<(499/500)/(2sqrt(2)).
mathematical_change.physical_scale: For the limiting physical forms, every angle remains below 3sqrt(2); near-parallel angles are below 0.998*3sqrt(2)=4.2341554057... .
mathematical_change.fourth_mode_extension: For delta>0 and c<=139/141, partner theorem plus the new Laplace inequality gives ||p||_infinity<=1/[2sqrt(2(1+delta))]; for c>=139/141 convolution preserves the 0.998 bound.

exact_finite_family: Two physical rows (alpha/sqrt2, +/- beta/sqrt2,0,0), plus diffuse banks completing diag(beta^2,alpha^2,1,1), give R_m^T R_m=I4 and A_m=R_m diag(1,1,-1,-delta)R_m^T with exact target spectrum; iid physical inputs are Unif[-1/2,1/2].
unpaid_implication: No universal upper bound for arbitrary cap-one product inputs and arbitrary symmetric A is proved. The centered equal-leverage two-heavy architecture is only a witness class.
next_step: Attack unequal-leverage two-heavy rotations using a weighted version of the triangle negative-association Laplace inequality; then three-heavy/fractured-law families if that closes.
